items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Lou ShooBe. He was the contractor, but he had a great deal to do with it.

ctx.x: That was CBS. Do you think CBS might have had something to do with that?
Yes, and to coincide with that, who was in the office there -- oh, he had something to do with it. Lou ShooBe. He was the contractor, but he had a great deal to do with it.

I'm sure it was John Hammond, because I was supposed to go in there, and I know that John had come to Cab Calloway's band, and Cozi Cole had been taken from Cab Calloway's band to join them, and John Hammond had been responsible for that.
